title: Kindly and Please (1/2)
titleZh: kindly 和 please 的差別（1/2）
summaryZh: 解說 kindly 與 please 的詞性差異，以及禮貌請求的用法。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Ask a Teacher

sentences.text: This week we received a question from Iguero in Nigeria.
sentences.zh: 這週我們收到來自奈及利亞的 Iguero 的問題。

sentences.text: What is the difference between please and kindly?
sentences.zh: please 和 kindly 有什麼不一樣？

sentences.text: Some use the two words together, e.g. please kindly assist.
sentences.zh: 有些人會把這兩個字放在一起用，例如 please kindly assist（請協助）。

sentences.text: Dear Iguero, thank you kindly for writing to us.
sentences.zh: 親愛的 Iguero，非常感謝你寫信給我們。

sentences.text: Kindly can be an adverb, a word that usually describes a verb.
sentences.zh: kindly 可以當副詞，也就是通常用來修飾動詞的字。

sentences.text: If your teacher says, kindly hand in your homework, she is using kindly as an adverb to make a polite request.
sentences.zh: 如果你的老師說 kindly hand in your homework（請交作業），她就是把 kindly 當副詞，用來客氣地提出要求。

sentences.text: Another way to use the word as an adverb is, the animal doctor always treats our pets kindly.
sentences.zh: 這個字當副詞的另一種用法是：獸醫對待我們的寵物一向很親切。

sentences.text: If someone helped you at the post office, you might say, a kindly man helped me mail my letter.
sentences.zh: 如果有人在郵局幫了你，你可能會說：有一位親切的先生幫我把信寄出去。

sentences.text: There, kindly describes man, which is a noun.
sentences.zh: 在這句話裡，kindly 修飾的是 man，也就是一個名詞。

sentences.text: You could also use the word nice to express the same idea.
sentences.zh: 你也可以用 nice 這個字來表達一樣的意思。

sentences.text: Please can be an adverb or a verb.
sentences.zh: please 可以當副詞，也可以當動詞。

sentences.text: It also can be used to make a request politely.
sentences.zh: 它同樣可以用來客氣地提出請求。

sentences.text: Would you please pass the salt?
sentences.zh: 可以麻煩你把鹽遞給我嗎？
